en: Color photograph of a grand baroque interior staircase with double sweeping stairways, richly carved balustrades, statues along the stairs, and large urns on the railings. The walls are highly ornamented with stucco reliefs and niches, and the ceiling above the staircase is covered by a large, dramatic fresco depicting historical or mythological scenes with many figures and vivid colors. The view looks down from the upper part of the staircase into a long vaulted corridor.
